## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). The footer is the record page's, drawn once. ⛔ No spec key

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T06:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** repeated provenance lines and a footer-only block. It is visual noise on a named producer (objectstack-ai/cloud's environment page). Nothing is wrong in the data.
- **The choice, made here: the host owns it.**
  - The record page draws one `RecordMetaFooter` for the record, whatever the number of `record:details` nodes.
  - A `DetailView` hosted on a record page no longer mounts its own. A standalone `DetailView` (no record-page host) keeps it.
  - ⛔ No `record:details` prop or spec key to switch it off. That would widen a published shape to work around a renderer's placement, and both measured faults are placement.
  - A node whose sections are all hidden then draws nothing.
  - **Pins:**
    - a page with two `record:details` nodes shows one footer;
    - an all-hidden node draws no block;
    - a standalone `DetailView` keeps its footer.
- Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` and the record-page host (`domain:ui`); rationale: one record, one footer.

Claim: PM loop round 1, next slot (as triage `6140111288` directs: the record page draws one `RecordMetaFooter` for the record, whatever the number of `record:details` nodes; a `DetailView` hosted on a record page no longer mounts its own, a standalone `DetailView` keeps it, and a node whose sections are all hidden draws nothing; ⛔ no `record:details` prop or spec key)

File surface, on objectui `main` `068a540`:
- **The footer's mount:** `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`, where it mounts `<RecordMetaFooter` unconditionally.
- **The record-page host:** whichever renders the record page's `record:details` nodes and can own one footer per record. The dev measures it: `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (which already says provenance is surfaced by `<RecordMetaFooter>`), or the `record:details` renderer in `packages/plugin-detail/src/`. How a hosted `DetailView` learns it is hosted (an existing context, or one the host provides) is also the dev's to measure.
- **Read and reused, ⛔ not changed:** `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordMetaFooter.tsx`.
- Co-located tests (the three pins), and `.changeset/12307-one-provenance-footer.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`, plus `@object-ui/app-shell` if touched; ⛔ never `major`).
- ⛔ No `record:details` prop, no spec key, and no new published prop on `DetailView` unless no other mechanism exists. If one must be added, stop and report it rather than ship it.
- (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: the published `DetailView` stops drawing its own footer when a record page hosts it, which narrows what it renders and widens no accept set. As a narrowing, it owes one contract-tier review before the queue. If the dev must add a published prop or export, the report says so and the line is re-judged.
Responsibility: `objectui's detail renderer (@object-ui/plugin-detail DetailView), which mounts RecordMetaFooter in every DetailView, so a record page with N record:details nodes draws N identical provenance footers and an all-hidden node draws a footer-only block | the record page itself is the one place that knows the page's record once (triage 6140111288) | every user of a record page that authors more than one record:details node, measured on objectstack-ai/cloud's sys_environment_detail page (2 footers, and 3 plus a footer-only block in a one-node-per-section variant)`
